note: The foxgloves, native zinnias and sages of 0.9.161. Foxgloves were redrawn and filled out; the two native zinnias redrawn (no cultivars are added: the garden zinnias are annuals and were left out by decision); the sages filled out. Sizes are MBG Plant Finder figures unless an estimate says otherwise; heightIn is the plant in flower.

sources.mbg: Missouri Botanical Garden Plant Finder, https://plantfinder.mobot.org/PlantFinderDetails.aspx?taxonid=<id>, read 2026-11-24

foxglove.estimates: Existing record kept (54 in; MBG 2-5 ft, zones 4-8). MBG flags it as invasive where it naturalizes; the blurb now says it escapes into clearings in the Pacific Northwest.

foxglove|pamschoice.estimates: MBG 3-4 ft x 1-2.5 ft; white with maroon throat and spotting.

foxglove|suttonsapricot.estimates: MBG 3-4 ft x 1-1.5 ft; pale apricot-orange, June-July.

foxglove|candymountain.estimates: MBG 3-4 ft, zones 4-9; pink, flowers facing up all round the stem.

rustyfoxglove|gelberherold.estimates: MBG 3-5 ft; yellow with rusty interior veining, June-July.

yellowfoxglove.estimates: MBG 2-3 ft x 1-1.5 ft, part shade, yellow, May-June in St Louis; bloom months set to June-July like the other foxgloves.

strawberryfoxglove.estimates: MBG 3-4 ft x 1-2 ft, coppery rose. D. purpurea x D. grandiflora, coming true from seed; Wikipedia files it under D. x fulva, recorded as a synonym. No wild range.

sunsetfoxglove.estimates: MBG 1-2 ft x 0.75-1.5 ft, rusty-orange to greenish-yellow; Spain and Morocco.

prairiezinnia.estimates: Existing record's figures kept (8 in, zones 4-9). Redrawn only.

desertzinnia.estimates: Existing record's figures kept (8 in, zones 6-10). Redrawn only.

meadowsage|eastfriesland.estimates: MBG 1-1.5 ft x 0.75-1 ft; violet purple. 'Ostfriesland' is the cultivar name, East Friesland its trade name.

meadowsage|snowhill.estimates: MBG 1.5-2 ft; white. Salvia x sylvestris 'Schneehugel', recorded as the other x sylvestris choices are.

meadowsage|rosequeen.estimates: MBG 1.5-2 ft; rose pink. Salvia x sylvestris.

autumnsage|furmansred.estimates: MBG 2-3 ft, zones 6-10. MBG's bloom field says pink; the cultivar is grown and named for its deep red, which is how it is drawn.

autumnsage|teresa.estimates: MBG 2-3 ft; white and pink bicolour, drawn as a pink hood over a white lip.

autumnsage|burgundyseduction.estimates: MBG 2.5-3 ft x 1.5-2 ft; dark magenta-red.

gardensage.estimates: MBG 2-2.5 ft square; blue, June. A woody subshrub: no spring cutback (noCutback), flower stems only in flower and seed.

whorledclary.estimates: MBG 1.5-2.5 ft x 1.5-2 ft, lilac blue, June-September.

whorledclary|purplerain.estimates: MBG 1-2 ft x 1.5-2.5 ft, smoky purple, July-September.

left_out.Salvia microphylla 'Hot Lips': Not in the MBG Plant Finder; no source read.
left_out.Salvia pratensis: MBG flags it as invasive where it has escaped; left out.
left_out.Digitalis purpurea Excelsior and Foxy Gr: Seed mixes of several colours, which one record cannot draw.
